parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ShareTaskId
parameters.description:
The **task ID** of the sharing task.

You can obtain the **task ID** on the **Shared Corpus Management** page in the **Voice Broadcast Service** console.

parameters.name: SpeechModelCodeList
parameters.description:
The list of **speech corpus identifiers** for the shared corpora. You can specify up to 10 **speech corpus identifiers**.

You can obtain the **speech corpus identifiers** on the **Task Details** page under **Shared Corpus Management** in the **Voice Broadcast Service** console.
